opening.argument: The presentation ties participation to paid packages and access to an earning system. It promises immediate withdrawals, stating, "You are paid today. You can do your withdrawal today." Access to the business academy and automated system is available only "after your payment is made," while the speaker describes passive income received for more than two years. The structure also depends on additional participants filling positions to produce a bonus, and the offer is associated with mining profitability of more than two million dollars. These claims present paid membership, recurring passive earnings, network participation, and a potentially very large payday as reasons to join, making the webinar a solicitation for an earnings scheme rather than a neutral explanation of Bitcoin mining.
